top_signals.title: Copper Set for Worst Run in Two Years on Nvidia and Rates Unease
top_signals.summary: Copper tumbled toward a fifth weekly loss — the longest run in nearly two years — on a wave of upheaval in the artificial-intelligence industry and growing expectations for further hikes in US interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Alice Huang tied to Nvidia’s biggest Chinese competitor
top_signals.summary: The woman with whom Jensen Huang reportedly had a relationship also owned stakes in companies that provided computing power to Huawei, a key Nvidia competitor.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Nvidia: Ex-prosecutor Joon Kim and Wachtell, Lipton bring big track record to investigation
top_signals.summary: The retention of Wachtell, Lipton for the Nvidia probe comes on the heels of the law firm's investigation for the NBA into the Los Angeles Clippers.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: EIA forecasts Alaskan crude oil production to grow 13% in 2027
top_signals.summary: After decades of decline, crude oil production in Alaska is growing, driven by two projects on Alaska's North Slope. In our latest Short-Term Energy Outlook, we expect a 23,000 barrels per day (b/d) (6%) increase in 2026, followed by a 60,000 b/d (13%) rise in 2027. At a forecast 505,000 b/d in 2027, output would be the most since 2014.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Ruling on 2025 election’s ‘unconstitutional state’ raises questions on electoral reform
top_signals.summary: While the results from last year's Upper House election are not invalidated, the ruling puts the debate on reform back into focus.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Indonesia’s Prabowo rushes end of Jokowi era with son’s ouster
top_signals.summary: Since taking office, Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto has increasingly put his own stamp on the government.
